name: authority-scope-inventory
objective: Re-establish the exact Captain-only authority, current branch pin, route/surface inventory, truth owners, inclusion test and evidence map before implementation.
truthOwner: Repository authority and current Product Truth/code evidence define scope; the package is derived support and cannot invent policy.

tasks.objective: Rebaseline Captain authority and scope from current BB
tasks.currentProblem: The old package pin and six-unit grouping no longer represent current Captain routes or dependencies.
tasks.requiredChange: Re-enumerate Product Truth, app-captain routes/screens, runtime/native capabilities, backend owners, contracts, data stores, cross-surface readers and current control-panel sections; bind each included item to a Captain effect and each exclusion to evidence plus a reopen condition.
tasks.targetState: A complete Captain-bounded coverage ledger with no unclassified surface/section and no unrelated product expansion.
tasks.action: Trace current callers and owners first; implement root-cause changes across the listed paths; delete proven obsolete Captain residue; then run the linked verification checks on the exact candidate and re-audit negative/concurrent/error paths.
mustNotChange: Do not create a parallel source of truth outside the declared owner.
Do not broaden implementation into unrelated product journeys merely because code is shared or a global check contains them.
Do not convert unavailable, ambiguous, stale or unauthorized state into a successful Captain result.
Do not preserve a proven dead or contradictory Captain path solely as an undocumented compatibility layer.
acceptanceCriteria: A complete Captain-bounded coverage ledger with no unclassified surface/section and no unrelated product expansion.
Happy, negative, unauthorized, retry/replay and applicable concurrency/offline states have executable evidence.
Every changed canonical value has an authorized readback and no local/demo value impersonates product truth.
Cleanup removes obsolete duplicate Captain code/config/copy after reachability proof without breaking valid consumers.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused unit implementation if required while preserving canonical persisted/audit/financial history; never restore a parallel truth or bypass to make rollback easier.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep U001 changes focused on authority-scope-inventory; reconcile BB movement before push and do not stage unrelated concurrent work.
